name: Breakdown shorts have negative expectancy
hypothesis: Screener 'breakdown' short signals lose money on average.
reason: Backtest (biased): breakdown n=47 independent signals, avg -0.44R, 95% CI [-0.79, -0.09] = PRELIMINARY. Needs forward confirmation.

name: rs_leader works better in Risk-On regimes
hypothesis: rs_leader signals have higher average R when the composite risk regime is Risk-On than when it is Mixed or Risk-Off.
reason: Backtest (biased): rs_leader x Risk-On n=482 avg +0.26R (BACKTEST-SUPPORTED) vs rs_leader x Mixed n=211 avg +0.01R.

name: Decision scorecard predicts outcomes
hypothesis: Paper trades with an overall scorecard ≥ 6 have higher average R than trades scoring < 6.
reason: V1.1 scorecard weights are judgment-based; the score may only influence ranking once it is shown to predict results.
